name: gridbricks-windpulse-platform
description: UK Wholesale Day-Ahead Renewable Generation Forecast & Accuracy Evaluation Platform with Neon PostgreSQL

scripts.server:start: bash -c 'if [ -d backend/venv ]; then ./backend/venv/bin/uvicorn backend.app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-8000}; else uvicorn backend.app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-8000}; fi'
scripts.server:start:show: bash -c 'if [ -d backend/venv ]; then ./backend/venv/bin/uvicorn backend.app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-8000} --reload; else uvicorn backend.app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-8000} --reload; fi'
scripts.server:build: bash -c 'python3 -m venv backend/venv && ./backend/venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip && ./backend/venv/bin/pip install -r backend/requirements.txt'
scripts.server:test: bash -c 'if [ -d backend/venv ]; then ./backend/venv/bin/pytest -v; else pytest -v; fi'
scripts.server:ingest: bash -c 'if [ -d backend/venv ]; then ./backend/venv/bin/python backend/scripts/ingest_data.py; else python3 backend/scripts/ingest_data.py; fi'
scripts.install:all: npm run server:build && npm run client:install
scripts.dev: npx --yes concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,emerald" "npm run server:start:show" "npm run client:start"

author: GridBricks Team
